children: Promoter Union (Mauritius) Holdings has acquired more than Rs 350 crore worth of equity shares in healthcare services provider Aster DM Quality Care from TPG-backed Centella Mauritius through open-market transactions on September 2.

According to bulk deal data on the stock exchanges, Union (Mauritius) Holdings, which is owned by Azad Moopen Mandayapurath and his family, bought 46.09 lakh shares, representing 0.52 percent of Aster DM Quality Care's paid-up equity, in the company.

Centella Mauritius Holdings, an investment vehicle owned by affiliates of global alternative asset management firm TPG, was the seller. The promoter acquired the shares for Rs 350.34 crore at a price of Rs 760 per share.
Centella Mauritius Holdings held a 9.9 percent stake in Aster DM Quality Care as of June 2026.
Unity Associates buys 0.67% stake in Shreeji Shipping Global from promoters
Unity Associates has acquired 10.98 lakh shares, or 0.67 percent of the paid-up equity, in logistics company Shreeji Shipping Global from its promoters for Rs 70.85 crore.
Promoters Ashok Kumar Haridas Lal and Lal Jitendra Haridas each sold 5.49 lakh shares in Shreeji Shipping Global at Rs 645.30 per share, with each transaction valued at Rs 35.42 crore.
Nexus Global Opportunities Fund acquires additional 1.13% stake in Wonder Electricals

Nexus Global Opportunities Fund has acquired an additional 15.22 lakh shares, representing a 1.13 percent stake in Wonder Electricals, for Rs 11.55 crore. The shares were purchased at Rs 75.85 apiece.

This follows the fund’s purchase of a 1.11 percent stake in Wonder Electricals in the previous session. As of June 2026, Nexus Global Opportunities Fund already held a 2.34 percent stake in the company.

title: Aster DM Quality Care promoter buys Rs 350 crore worth shares from TPG-Backed Centella Mauritius
